title: DTRA official collecting documents on extraterrestrials
summary: unnamed speaker tells of DTRA official collecting documents on extraterrestrials, about undated at Defense Threat Reduction Agency SCIF, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: person in charge of collecting all of the information from Ditra dealing with extraterrestrials and as he put it quote unquote little green men happened to sit next to me at my computer terminal and began pulling all the documents on my system and the systems in our skiff.

plain: An unnamed speaker says he once worked inside a secure room for classified work, called a SCIF, at the Defense Threat Reduction Agency, a US military agency that deals with weapons threats. He says the official in charge of gathering everything the agency had on extraterrestrials, "little green men" as the official put it, sat at his computer and pulled every related document from his system. If true, it would mean the government quietly collects such files.
